text:
The review is written to `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/09/spawned/mastermind-ui-kit/step-1/review/report.md`, with verdict `fix` and five `[fix]` findings plus two notes.

I made no code edits, ran no tests, and did not run the new key handler. The code review rests on reading the diff and the shots.

The five fixes:
1. The shots cover only the old `/framework/ui/card/` page. None of the new variants (`titled`, `stack`, `tree-rows`, `fit`) is shown, so their layout, sizing and spacing are unchecked.
2. The two `location.search` urls from the ArrowDown test are not in the task log, and no Library test was added.
3. Stale text remains. `ui/card/page.js` still has the heading "Four variants, not six", and `ui/card/doc/architecture.md` still names the renamed `list` variant.
4. `ux/Inbox/readme.md` still presents `.flush-stack` as the Inbox's own rule. It now lives in `framework.css`.
5. The task folder isn't enough to continue from. The log ends with a harness-completed close, with no outcome, commit list or smoke result. The "ui-kit gap" line has no follow-up task, and four extra pngs in `shots/` are unindexed.
